title: Pretraining for Forecasting in Relational Databases
abstract: arXiv:2611.33645v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Real-world forecasting increasingly relies on asynchronous transaction logs in relational databases rather than uniformly sampled arrays. While relational deep learning (RDL) models can forecast from these complex histories, they are typically trained separately for each specific target and root entity type. We introduce Query-Conditioned Relational pretraining (QCRP), a self-supervised framework that enables a standard RDL backbone to act as a universal forecaster across a database. QCRP generates diverse forecasting objectives using a structured temporal query grammar and interleaves them through a shared conditional predictor. This produces a robust, frozen encoder reusable for downstream tasks via lightweight predictors or a zero-shot interface. translated_title: 关系数据库中面向预测任务的预训练
translated_abstract: 现实世界中的预测任务越来越多地依赖于关系数据库中的异步事务日志，而非均匀采样的数组。虽然关系深度学习（RDL）模型能够基于这些复杂的历史数据进行预测，但它们通常需要针对每个特定的目标和根实体类型分别训练。我们提出了查询条件关系预训练，这是一种自监督框架，使标准的RDL骨干网络能够充当整个数据库的通用预测器。QCRP使用结构化的时间查询语法生成多样化的预测目标，并通过共享的条件预测器将它们交错训练。由此产生了一个鲁棒的、冻结的编码器，可通过轻量级预测器或零样本接口重用于下游任务。在大规模RelBench数据库上的评估表明，QCRP学习到的冻结表示能够在跨任务、跨实体类型的预测中取得有竞争力的表现。此外，单一统一的QCRP模型（摘要截断）……
tldr: 提出查询条件关系预训练（QCRP）自监督框架，利用结构化时间查询语法生成多样化预测目标，使标准关系深度学习骨干网络成为数据库上的通用预测器，其冻结表示可经轻量级预测器或零样本接口复用于各类下游预测任务。
en_tdlr: QCRP is a self-supervised query-conditioned pretraining framework that turns a standard relational deep learning backbone into a universal forecaster across a database, producing frozen representations reusable for downstream forecasting via lightweight predictors or a zero-shot interface.
